name: Prospective structure-guided shared-parameter learning in Mirror virtual supergraphs
question: Does cutting paths in order to improve future shared-core learning outperform pruning by instantaneous importance, random cutting, no cutting, and same final graph trained from scratch?
mirror_insertion: 4-node 2-view fully connected directed virtual MLP supergraph, 32 edges, D=8, two loops; one learned 128-coordinate physical core, 32x4 trainable page addresses, 32 edge gate logits; nonlinear fixed Householder-tanh-inverse Householder decoding
candidate_operations: At two intervention events remove four edges; lookahead policy compares four heuristic sets and keep using cloned optimizer/state, six trial learning steps on identical future training batches; growth, node, view and loop change are intentionally deferred

data.target_mean_var: No oracle teacher target normalizer; normalize NMSE with train-only target RMS
data.teacher_access: Teacher parameters are never given to student; use teacher cloned parameters only for oracle representability audit after frozen dev training

architecture.edge_weight_decoder: fixed signed permutations and nonlinear Householder sandwich, tanh or affine control
architecture.edge_prune_timing: after shared-core/graph warmup, no repruning for baseline

training.initial_seed_rule: world+seed, same initial weights within variant
training.schedule: same shuffled minibatch indices for paired methods

post_training_control: mirror_from_start_same_mask; replay selected final lookahead mask from initial parameters and same batch sequence for 260 updates; compute charged separately
primary_metric: fresh NMSE divided by fixed train-only target mean-square relative to zero predictor

decision.trajectory_pass: Mirror lookahead fresh NMSE is >=5% smaller than mirror_from_start_same_mask AND mirror_random AND mirror_low_gate for >=5 of 6 world-seed paired trials
decision.mirror_specific_pass: Mirror lookahead fresh NMSE >=5% smaller than both direct_tanh_lookahead and affine_lookahead at 5/6 pairs; record resources, no adoption if excessive runtime
decision.mechanism: In >=4 of 6 pairs, cutting changes shared physical core gradient direction >=5 degrees on fixed training batch; oracle representability <= 1e-5 MSE on aligned world if true teacher is copied into student
decision.efficiency: Hard edges reduce 32->24 and are physically not generated/executed; account program metadata; compare actual walltime, serialized bytes and total (probe+real) updates
decision.no_claim: Successful mechanism alone is not a capacity proof, arbitrary MLP theorem, language-model generalization, or proof of search global optimum

selection_policy: Development split only; fresh evaluated once after all train and from-start-mask checkpoints frozen and hashed; do not tune from fresh; negative outcomes retained
statistical_scope: 6 paired synthetic world/seed observations, descriptive only; predeclared thresholds; include best and worst per-pair and separate per-world tables
